name: stack-profiles
description: Standalone home of the stack-profiles Claude Code plugin, extracted from locriani/ai-additions.

plugins.name: stack-profiles
plugins.description: Per-stack rule addenda (11 stacks: Swift/Apple, bash, Python/uv, Node/TypeScript, Postgres, Rust, Go, React/Vite, Rails, Terraform, Kubernetes) plus a SessionStart hook that detects the repo's stack and loads only the matching profile.
